You will need to test these settings by yourself. The Auto Tuning process is based upon a

Please make sure that the Temperature Controller is running with its default PID settings
before you use Auto Tuning. Most thermal models will be controllable with the
default PID settings. Under "Temperature Control" set the "CHx Temperature Controller PID Values"
to its default values: Kp = 10; Ti = 300; Td = 0.
Set the desired target temperature. If it will be necessary to use different target temperatures,
then it is recommended to use the highest possible target temperature.
Usually this leads to more reliable PID values.
Set the TEC-Controller to "ON" in the "Operation" tab and wait until the Target Temperature is
reached and the Temperature has stabilized.
Start the Auto Tuning process and observe the process on the Chart tab. If the process fails,
try the fast or slow Model.
